correctness.rationale: The claimed optimum, uniqueness and fixed-r asymptotics are correct. Strict convexity on positive Laplacians restricted to the constants' orthogonal complement justifies averaging over the two edge orbits; irreducibility holds under averaging and strict inequality holds for a non-invariant input. Independently, for N=n(r+1), each pendant bridge contributes its inverse conductance to exactly N−1 unordered resistances, and each core pair's resistance appears (r+1)² times. Dividing total resistance by N gives K=(r+1)C_H/a + nr(N−1)/(Nb), the same A/b as the block proof, including r=1 and n=2. Monotonicity saturates the core row constraint, and minimizing R/u+S/(1−u) over 0<u<1 proves the interior positive solution and rules out disconnected endpoints. Substituting the cycle and complete-core trace constants yields the stated finite comparator formula and limits, without any aperiodicity assumption. The rational checker and its limits were inspected, not executed.

evidence: The one-leaf proof counts four copies of each core-pair resistance, and 2n−1 contributions per pendant bridge; divide by 2n. Repeating these very same counts with a cluster of r+1 vertices simply replaces four by (r+1)², 2n−1 by N−1, and the pendant sum by the sum over nr edges. In particular the complete weighted identity is tr(L_G⁺)=(r+1)tr(L_core⁺)+(1−1/N) Σ_pendant 1/w_e.

After the identical orbit averaging, the only constraint change is da+b≤1 to da+rb≤1 and the same inverse-cost minimization applies. Substituting C_H=(n−1)/n into the existing one-leaf formula gives the one-leaf clique penalty, and the all-r cycle/clique limits follow by leading-term substitution in the same weighted identity.
